title: CODEX: A Comprehensive Knowledge Graph Completion Benchmark
benchmark_measurement: Factual knowledge graph completion (link prediction and triple classification) in the domain of religion, as part of a broader multi-domain benchmark.
findings: The paper does not report specific findings related to the religion domain. The findings focus on the overall performance of different knowledge graph embedding models on the CODEX benchmark, analyzing their ability to capture relational patterns like symmetry and compositionality across all domains.
